purpose: Measure stable, identity-free aggregates of the visible rendered surface for later research evaluation.
non_claims: This contract does not estimate authorship probability.
This contract does not estimate a percentage of AI-written code.
This contract does not measure security.
Passing the pilot stability gate does not establish predictive usefulness.
feature_source: Successful Option B v3 minimal rendered-surface payloads only.

stability_gate.comparison_unit: same sample and viewport across two runs
stability_gate.criterion: Every absolute per-feature drift must be less than or equal to its preregistered tolerance.
